description.value: Olivier's La Boulangerie is an artisan French bakery and café founded by a family who relocated from Southern France to Vancouver, introducing authentic slow-fermented breads to Western Canada in 2009. The Fraser Street location is the brand's largest Vancouver outpost, set in the Fraserhood neighbourhood with exclusive menu items not available at other locations. All products are made without chemical preservatives, GMO grain, or high-gluten elements by master bakers from France.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 9m; stands (2 spaces) at 11m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 38m; stands (2 spaces) at 43m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at oliviersbreads.com confirms the Fraser Street location (3885 Fraser St, Vancouver, BC V5V 4E3) matches the OSM address and is an active artisan French bakery and café. The site has current content including 2026 event calendar bookings, confirming the business is open. No bike parking, water bottle refill, or any amenity-related information appears anywhere in the website text, so all amenity fields default to null.
concerns: No phone number in OSM; the website lists (778)-285-8662 but it is displayed under the Coquitlam main location header, not clearly associated with the Fraser Street location.
The /store subpage labels Hornby St as 'OPENING SOON' while the homepage already lists it as an active location, suggesting some web pages are out of sync — does not affect the Fraser Street listing.
Category mapped to Groceries via shop=bakery; the business is a bakery/café rather than a general grocery store.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible artisan bakery and café with an active website, confirmed Fraser Street location, and 2026 event bookings indicating ongoing operation.
